prefix.content: Can you show me a renewable penetration trend over time for the top-performing utilities?

**🚀 Nauru — the most dramatic transformation.** From just 8% in FY2022 to 100% in FY2024. That's a complete diesel-to-renewable transition in two years — almost certainly driven by a major solar+storage project. Remarkable for a small island nation.

**🍃 Te Aponga (Cook Islands) — a similar leap.** Sitting at ~12–13% for two years, then jumping to 92% in FY2024. Another large-scale renewable investment clearly came online.

**🇫🇯 Energy Fiji — the long-standing leader, but slipping slightly.** At 96% in FY2022, dropping to 88% in FY2023, and no FY2024 data submitted yet. Worth watching — a drop of that size usually reflects either increased diesel backup use or a hydro shortfall year.

**📈 PNG Power — steady, consistent growth.** 45% → 52% → 65%. Not flashy, but disciplined progress. They're now well above the 50% PPA target.
